market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.6 and falling; July CPI in line at 3.4% and a lighter PPI eased yields, though the 10-year (4.68%) stays near its 1-year high. Crude jumped 11% in 5 days on renewed Hormuz attacks.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: 'Oil prices rise as attacks dent hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening' (Al Jazeera) is already priced (WTI +10.7%, XOM +5.4% in 5 days)
oil_gas.reasoning: The re-entry trigger (renewed attacks) appeared, but crude has already repriced to 83 and XOM is 7% off its high. Deal-or-escalation risk is two-sided and Trump pressure on majors persists. Stay flat.

gold_miners.catalyst: Barrick-Newmont $1.95B Nevada JV settlement (previous note) plus 'Treasury yields ease after lighter-than-expected wholesale inflation' (CNBC); 'Newmont backs explorer Headwater on 3rd Nevada gold project' (Mining.com)
gold_miners.reasoning: Holding the NEM long opened 2026-08-10. No negative settlement details seen; lower yields support gold (4468, +3.8% in 5 days). NEM is up 24% in a month, so upside is partly priced; hold to about 2026-08-24.

chips.catalyst: none: no export-rule or guidance headline; only a technical-levels note on NVDA
chips.reasoning: NVDA is 5% off its high after a 3% up day. Late-August earnings are a two-sided scheduled event, not a reason to be long. No named catalyst.

pharma.catalyst: LLY Q2 guidance raise (previous note), still being rewarded: LLY +4.3% in 5 days and 1.2% off its high; no drug-pricing headline in the record
pharma.reasoning: Holding the LLY long from 2026-08-05 for its remaining days (to about 2026-08-19). Pharma headlines concern Medicaid and Medicare policy, not drug pricing. No exit trigger hit.

copper_uranium.catalyst: Congo copper and cobalt concentrate export ban (Reuters, previous note); 'COMMENTARY: Copper's Congo panic says more about copper than Congo' (Reuters) frames it as a sign of an already tight market
copper_uranium.reasoning: Holding the FCX long from 2026-07-31. Copper eased 1.6% in 5 days but is still 1.6% off its 1-year high; no ban reversal or exemption seen. The commentary hints the panic is fading, so confidence is only marginal.

would_change_my_mind: A Congo ban exemption or copper falling below its 20-day level, a yield rebound above the 1-year high hitting gold, or drug-pricing news on LLY would trigger exits; a fresh Hormuz closure with crude lagging would reopen XOM.

handoff.what_changed: Al Jazeera: attacks dented hopes for a Hormuz reopening; WTI 83.3 (+10.7% in 5 days), already priced, so XOM stays flat. CPI in line (3.4% y/y) and a lighter PPI eased yields, helping gold (4468) and NEM (+13% in 5 days). Reuters commentary says the Congo copper panic reflects an already tight market; copper eased 1.6% in 5 days, FCX flat.

oil_gas.why: Renewed Hormuz attacks are already priced (crude +10.7%, XOM +5.4% in 5 days); no one-sided catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Barrick settlement clears uncertainty and easing yields support gold; no negative deal details seen.

chips.why: No export-rule or guidance catalyst; NVDA late-August earnings are two-sided.

pharma.why: Guidance raise still rewarded (+4.3% in 5 days, near high); no drug-pricing news.

copper_uranium.why: Congo concentrate export ban keeps copper tight (1.6% off 1-year high); no reversal seen.

open_storylines.name: Iran war / Hormuz oil shock
open_storylines.note: Al Jazeera: attacks dent reopening hopes; WTI 83.3, Brent 89. Already repriced; re-enter XOM only on a new closure with crude not yet moved.

open_storylines.name: Trump vs oil majors' windfall
open_storylines.note: No new action seen; watch for a windfall tax, export limits or SPR releases (negative for XOM).

open_storylines.name: Gold bear market and rising yields
open_storylines.note: Gold 4468, 16% below high; 10-year 4.68% near 1-year high but eased on lighter PPI. A yield rebound would hurt NEM.

open_storylines.name: Barrick-Newmont Nevada settlement and IPO
open_storylines.note: $1.95B settlement, NEM long; NEM +24% in a month and backing Headwater on a 3rd Nevada project. Exit on negative details; hold ends about 2026-08-24.

open_storylines.name: Chip rout and rebound
open_storylines.note: SOXX +2.7% in 5 days, NVDA 5% off high. Watch NVDA earnings late August and export rules.

open_storylines.name: US inflation and tariffs
open_storylines.note: July CPI +0.1% m/m, 3.4% y/y as expected; PPI lighter. Watch Fed odds, tariff carve-outs and retaliation.

open_storylines.name: LLY Q2 guidance raise
open_storylines.note: LLY long, 1.2% off high. Exit on a sell-off or drug-pricing news; hold ends about 2026-08-19.

open_storylines.name: Copper supply squeeze
open_storylines.note: Congo concentrate export ban; Reuters commentary says panic reflects tight copper. Copper 6.60 (-1.6% in 5 days). Exit on ban reversal or exemption, mine restarts, dollar rebound or copper reversal; hold ends about 2026-08-28.

open_storylines.name: Uranium: producer updates and mill opposition
open_storylines.note: Uranium ETF +5.4% in 5 days; NPR on uranium mill and tribal health concerns. Indirect for FCX.

open_storylines.name: Copper to aluminium substitution
open_storylines.note: FCX demand headwind if more automakers switch; no update.

handoff.next_job: On the next decision day, read this note. Exit LLY at about 2026-08-19 or earlier on a sell-off or pricing news. Hold NEM to about 2026-08-24 unless yields rebound sharply or settlement details turn negative. Hold FCX to about 2026-08-28 unless the Congo ban is reversed or exempted or copper reverses. Re-check XOM (Hormuz, Trump actions) and NVDA (earnings date, export rules) for a named, unpriced catalyst.
